sentences.text:
Siddharth Aswal S/o Lt. Sh. Nathuram Aswal, aged about 41  years, Plot No. 3, Sector-1, ITI Circle, JNV Colony, Bikaner  (Raj.).
 ----Petitioner  Versus  1. The State of Rajasthan, through P.P.

2. Satya Narain Godara, aged about 40 years, present  S.H.O. of Police Station Sadar Bikaner, District Bikaner  (Raj.).
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Rajak Khan

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Rajesh Panwar, Sr. Advocate-cum-  AAG  Mr. Deepak Choudhary, G.A.-cum-  AAG  Mr. Vikram Singh Rajpurohit, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP TANEJA Order 07/10/2025 1.

By way of filing this instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.0193/2021, dated 06.05.2021, registered at Police Station Sadar Bikaner, District Bikaner for the offences punishable under Sections 420 & 120B IPC; Section 3 & 7 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 and Section 17, 17(a), 17(b), 27(b)(i), 27(c) & 27(d) of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act.

2. In this case, final report/closure report was submitted before the competent authority and accordingly a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 23rd September, 2022 dismissed the (Uploaded on 07/10/2025 at 06:04:54 PM) [2025:RJ-JD:44002] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-2693/2021]
misc. petition as having become infructuous.

However, the petition was kept pending for monitoring of the report submitted by way of affidavit for providing necessary help to the learned Public Prosecutor for the purpose of efficient and expeditious assistance to this Court.

5. All pending application(s) stand disposed of.
